channel.title: Educa Game Blog
channel.description: Ideas for parents and teachers to teach math and logical reasoning with games.

item.title: Math games for kids: how to choose one that really teaches
item.description: Not every "educational" game teaches. See 7 signs of a good math game for kids, the warning signs, and how to use the game at home without fighting over screen time.

item.title: How to teach times tables without rote memorization: strategies and 6 activities to do at home
item.description: Times tables don't have to be rote memorization. See how to teach multiplication with meaning, the tricks that shrink the hard facts down to 15, and 6 simple activities to practice at home.

item.title: Math in Brazil's BNCC, Grades 1 to 5: what children learn each year
item.description: A simple guide to the Mathematics section of Brazil's national curriculum (BNCC) for the early grades: how to read the skill codes (EF02MA07 and others), the five thematic units and what is expected each year, from Grade 1 to Grade 5.

item.title: Logical reasoning for kids: 7 activities with patterns, sequences and balance scales
item.description: Logical reasoning can be trained like any other skill. See 7 simple activities, with examples and answers, to do at home or at school, and what Brazil's BNCC says about the topic.

item.title: Sudoku for kids: benefits, rules and how to start with 4×4
item.description: Sudoku is a great logic exercise for kids and doesn't require any arithmetic. See the benefits, the rules explained for children, a 4×4 to solve together and tips to move forward.
